description: This file defines layout elements, parameters, and UI components related to a confirmation dialog UI in an Android project, utilizing teeui library components and custom styling.

classes.name: IconShield
classes.description: A label element displaying a shield icon, styled with a specific font and size.

classes.name: LabelTitle
classes.description: A label element displaying the title text for the confirmation UI.

classes.name: IconOk
classes.description: A button element representing the OK/Confirm action.

classes.name: LabelOK
classes.description: A label element with the 'Confirm' text inside the OK button.

classes.name: LabelCancel
classes.description: A label element with the 'Cancel' text.

classes.name: LabelHint
classes.description: A label providing descriptive hint text.

classes.name: LabelBody
classes.description: A label displaying the main body/more detailed message.

classes.name: ConfUILayout
classes.description: A layout grouping all the UI elements of the confirmation dialog.

methods.name: HeightFromLines
methods.description: Calculates height based on number of text lines, used for layout sizing.

methods.name: BOTTOM_EDGE_OF
methods.description: Calculates the bottom edge position of a given element.
